thread:
hana: exploring batched authz at the edge. idea: fold concurrent requests, send one envelope to auth, then expand for billing. main worry: GDPR and PII in telemetry.

jorge: we must never include raw token or user email in the envelope. keep token_hash and a user_id_hash. For EU customers we should strip free-text fields.

liz: UX: console should flag "sampled" vs "full" audit rows. If we compress envelopes, add X-RW-Trace and include a privacy_mode flag per-item.

hana: good. privacy_mode=redact will mask user identifiers in expanded events but still attribute to project/org for billing. okay?

jorge: yep, but billing needs project/org to be intact. suggest envelope item: {sub_id, org, project, sa, token_hash, privacy_mode}. auth returns decisions in same order.

gdpr-bot: (automated) Reminder: storing hashed identifiers is allowed; keep salt secret and rotate annually. See policy: /policy/gdpr-audit.

liz: rollout: 1% canary EU-only, mirror decomposed events to staging billing, verify parity and that no PII leaks. Add metric: batch_privacy_violations = 0.

hana: I'll draft proto for envelope and a short privacy audit checklist. Putting draft PR up this afternoon. :thumbsup:
